headline: Business Services Sector Generated Over EUR 35 Billion in the Local Economy in 2025 and Surpassed 280,000 Employees. Deloitte: Romania Remains One of the Most Competitive Markets in the Region
summary: Romania's business services industry generated EUR 35.5 billion in gross added value in 2025, about 10 percent of the economy, and employed over 280,000 people, according to Deloitte.
why: Business services such as shared service centres and outsourcing are a major source of employment and foreign investment in Central and Eastern Europe.
